title.zh: 对第 260 号共和国法的修改
title.en: An Act Amending Section Two of Presidential Decree No. 260, as Amended, Declaring as Historical Landmark All Ancestral Houses Along Rizal Street, Silay City, Negros Occidental
title.orig: An Act Amending Section Two of Presidential Decree No. 260, as Amended, Declaring as Historical Landmark All Ancestral Houses Along Rizal Street, Silay City, Negros Occidental

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_8058_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Section 2 of Presidential Decree No. 260, as amended, is hereby further amended to include as historical landmark all ancestral houses along Rizal Street, Silay City, Negros Occidental.
The executive director and/or chairman of the National Historical Institute shall implement the provisions of this Act.
All laws, decrees, orders, rules and regulations and other issuances or parts thereof inconsistent with this Act shall be repealed or amended accordingly.
This Act shall take effect upon approval.
